name: deck-numbers-check
description: Checks every figure in a drafted deck and returns a Numbers Register (each figure with slide, source, base, period and status), a mismatch list across slides and against the source doc, and the chart each figure needs, with unsourced figures marked draft. Use for "run deck-numbers-check", "check the numbers in this deck", "trace every figure", "do these numbers match", "is anything made up", "numbers before the board", "which chart for this figure", part of the Claude Slides for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
